# Birthday ephemera for twenty-five

Original image_gen artwork directed by the owner's two supplied birthday-scrapbook references and confirmed age 25. The motifs use photographed-paper, vintage-print and foil qualities: silver 25 balloons with pink bows, bunting, foil stars, heart postage, romantic love cards, a heart cake, retro digital camera, disco ball, varied-type paper phrases and a red/blue toy-car couple. These are generated decorative objects, not photographs of a personal event or additional interactive controls.

## Source and delivery

- Generated PNG: `exec-87018619-3b5a-46e5-83a6-c7b1fcaf4ba3.png`, 1448 × 1086 RGBA.
- PNG SHA256: `55139889c9a4c6f9337ed17306f99749059db7c4218f64771e720a0e2731b558`.
- Delivery: `birthday-25-ephemera.webp`, 1448 × 1086 RGBA, 633,620 bytes.
- WebP SHA256: `859e4cafd299bc5ab638cf77468c0c3bd2e19f7afe195130fe14ae1d4c0b225d`.
- The complete source dimensions and every alpha byte are preserved. No source crop, resize, recoloring, background replacement or alpha cleanup is applied.
- Each motif has a separately measured rectangular display frame in `fandom-stickers.js`. The frames retain every source pixel above alpha 1. Pixels outside all frames have at most alpha 1/255.
- Bright fringe RGB visible in a raw transparency preview is carried by near-transparent pixels: the measured yellow speckles have alpha 1–3/255. These have negligible contribution on the paper background. The original color and alpha are retained.

## Placement

Fifteen placements use eleven motifs. The heart-shaped cake is retained on the source sheet but is not placed over the existing interactive birthday cake. The source collection keeps every earlier item; nine minor old ornament placements give their positions to the new birthday pieces.

The image-led front receives only the new silver 25, keeping its existing artwork, live Polaroid writing and missing-image fallback. The old eight front ornaments stay omitted. Interior pieces include the camera and car pair beside the four-day recap, disco and favorite-person label by the photograph, stars and bunting near the folded letter, a second 25 beside the birthday cake, and love cards/postage by the gift. No caption is added beneath any piece.

The existing atlas-frame pipeline uniformly contains each full motif. Native pieces sit on their paper; actual Three meshes follow the hinged cover and curled page geometry. They are decorative, hidden from the accessibility tree and do not add focus targets, pointer interception or idle animation. The cover semantic title and birthday heading expose age 25 as normal accessible English text.

The favorite-person phrase uses a foreground-print flag so its complete words remain visible over the photograph's blank lower-right paper. It stays a separate loose piece on the page while the photograph is opened, with one restored source and no duplicate in the reader.

The five personal cat illustrations and existing driver, singer, football and club images retain their original sources. Credits for those separate assets remain in their existing provenance files.
